example_research_questions: Can full-gene representation improve target-specific response under the VCC25 evaluator?
Can a provenance-safe target-to-gene prior add signal beyond H1 global context and GWPS residual?
Is raw-count tokenization useful only with a generative model family designed for discrete counts?
forbidden_assumptions: Do not copy Lingshu source, checkpoint, clue CSV, training loop, or fixed hyperparameters into new candidates.
Do not treat this skill as requiring Lingshu implementation.
Do not use validation/test expression or official hidden labels for feature construction.
Do not bypass VCC25 evaluator, split, or benchmark contract.
Do not use the Lingshu ~0.24 Pearson-Delta reference as a hard acceptance criterion.
Do not call a proposal Lingshu-style unless it reports mechanism alignment and approximation gaps.
Do not equate masked reconstruction with perturbation-conditioned generation.
Do not equate formal CFG syntax with meaningful classifier-free guidance unless conditional and neutral/control paths differ through learned perturbation signal during sampling.
Do not keep iterating a single weak architecture if evidence indicates the bottleneck is objective, conditioning, target-specific information, generation, or model family.

autonomous_skill_v1.finding: Skill v1 produced a DB-PCPD-inspired graph-delta candidate with Pearson-Delta 0.042183; graph propagation alone did not recover Lingshu-level perturbation prediction.

autonomous_skill_v2.finding: Skill v2 produced a minimal masked-generative candidate with Pearson-Delta 0.0000699; mechanism audit found raw-count tokens, masks, condition labels, and CFG were present only at the surface level, without a perturbation-conditioned response objective.

autonomous_skill_v6_gfect.failure_lesson: The main official trial used shuffled_target_control=true, so it evaluated a negative-control behavior rather than the primary learned target-to-effect mechanism.
autonomous_skill_v6_gfect.finding: GFECT improved over prior autonomous Lingshu-skill candidates but remains far below Lingshu reference.
autonomous_skill_v6_gfect.next_implication: Separate primary candidate from falsification controls; do not merely tune GFECT scalars; consider stronger target-to-gene signal, perturbation-conditioned objective, gene-position conditioning, generation/sampling, or model-family change.

autonomous_skill_v7_ps_de_vae.failure_lesson: Control-only regulatory profiles describe baseline co-expression, not intervention-aware target-to-gene perturbation effects. Model sophistication cannot compensate for missing target-specific perturbation signal.
autonomous_skill_v7_ps_de_vae.finding: A richer VAE/contrastive/FiLM/gene-position decoder did not improve when its target-specific signal came only from control-derived co-expression/regulatory profiles.
autonomous_skill_v7_ps_de_vae.next_implication: Avoid another control-coexpression or PS-DE-VAE dimensional tweak; choose a materially different direction or add a genuinely intervention-aware target-to-gene signal and objective.

binary_lingshu_clue_component.finding: Binary Lingshu-style target-gene clue injected into the existing backbone scored 0.604538 vs current 0.612344 with 0/9 wins; this does not test full Lingshu.

h1_global_prior.finding: All-150 H1 global template improved over 136-anchor template by +0.0002940871 across 9/9 seed-fold runs and +0.0002460368 across 3/3 quick-confirm seeds.

simple_distribution_summary.finding: Mean+variance, responder fraction, and uncertainty/count summaries all trailed mean-only representation.

target_specific_residual.finding: H1 target-specific residual is large, but current GO, embedding, kNN, and PC1/PC2 predictors did not reliably improve held-out reconstruction.

last_completed_official_run.failure_lesson: Control-only regulatory profiles describe baseline co-expression, not intervention-aware target-to-gene perturbation effects. Model sophistication cannot compensate for missing target-specific perturbation signal.
last_completed_official_run.finding: A richer VAE/contrastive/FiLM/gene-position decoder did not improve when its target-specific signal came only from control-derived co-expression/regulatory profiles.
last_completed_official_run.next_implication: Avoid another control-coexpression or PS-DE-VAE dimensional tweak; choose a materially different direction or add a genuinely intervention-aware target-to-gene signal and objective.

limitations: Original Lingshu training workflow is not present in local release or historical artifacts.
Lingshu clue provenance is UNKNOWN for scientific use in current VCC25 investigation.
Lingshu binary clue failure in the current backbone is not evidence that full Lingshu model design fails.

lingshu_reference_result.meaning: Original Lingshu reference result for VCC H1; use as mechanism-attribution motivation, not as current-project baseline or acceptance gate.

mechanism_attribution.dependency: Most useful when paired with a model that can exploit gene-gene dependencies.
mechanism_attribution.problem_addressed: Avoids making sparse or pathway-specific perturbation effects unavailable to the model.
mechanism_attribution.transferability: HIGH as a representation audit/experiment; compute cost must be controlled.
mechanism_attribution.what_it_is: Model-facing representation preserves gene-specific expression over the official-scale gene panel instead of HVG-only or target-mean summaries.

mechanism_attribution.dependency: Requires a tokenizer and discrete/masked objective; do not feed log1p deltas into this contract.
mechanism_attribution.problem_addressed: Gives the generative model a count-compatible state space rather than continuous deltas.
mechanism_attribution.transferability: MEDIUM; needs explicit tokenizer compatibility smoke.
mechanism_attribution.what_it_is: Raw integer counts are encoded as discrete expression tokens.

mechanism_attribution.dependency: Requires condition information that is predictive for unseen targets.
mechanism_attribution.problem_addressed: Keeps perturbation intent visible instead of hiding it in averaged labels.
mechanism_attribution.what_it_is: Perturbation target and cell/context condition are model inputs separate from expression tokens.

mechanism_attribution.dependency: Requires provenance-clean source and matched gene order.
mechanism_attribution.problem_addressed: Supplies target-specific affected-gene information missing from GO/generic embeddings.
mechanism_attribution.transferability: HIGH for safe external priors; UNKNOWN for Lingshu clue CSV due provenance.
mechanism_attribution.what_it_is: Target-to-gene evidence influences gene-level generation or prediction positions.

mechanism_combination_warning.binary_clue_negative_result_scope: The binary Lingshu-style clue ablation failed only as an isolated component in the existing backbone; it does not test raw-count tokenization, masked generation, classifier-free guidance, or sampling-time clue use.
mechanism_combination_warning.proposal_requirement: A proposal should state which mechanisms it implements, which are absent, and why the approximation may still transfer.
mechanism_combination_warning.summary: Lingshu reference behavior is plausibly a coupled system, not a bag of independent keywords.

purpose: Provide transferable Lingshu-Cell data processing and representation insights for VCC25 H1 autonomous research without copying Lingshu implementation or assets.

skill_v3_mechanism_lesson.central_chain: target -> target-specific biological or learned signal -> perturbation-conditioned objective -> conditional whole-transcriptome generation/prediction -> guided perturbed expression output
requirements: Raw-count tokenization must be paired with an objective that learns target-specific perturbation response.
Masked reconstruction must be conditioned on perturbation and control/neutral contrast, not just observed expression recovery.
Target condition must influence gene positions via learned target embeddings, response supervision, target-to-gene priors, or another explicit gene-specific mechanism.
Biological prior, if used, must be provenance-clean and integrated into conditioning, masking, logits, sampling, residual prediction, or loss.

skill_v4_autonomous_execution_lesson.observed_failure: Skill v3 generated a stronger ResearchStudio idea, Target-Forced Disentangled Conditional Transport, but Heuresis translated it into a request to patch Candidate G/R with a DE mask. That run was stopped before H200.
requirements: A novel representation or target-specific mechanism must compile to a standalone autonomous_research_candidate.
Do not patch Candidate G/R or Candidate R-specific implementation as the primary implementation of a new Lingshu-seeded proposal.
Shared infrastructure such as data loading, gene-order validation, H5AD writing, rjob packaging, and Cell-Eval is allowed.

The formal VCC25 execution baseline now provides a generic autonomous candidate route. New proposals should use candidate_variant = autonomous_research_candidate and candidate-local allowed_paths only. Do not include tasks/vcc25/official_h1_adapter.py, controller_bash/scripts/task_contract.py, or controller_bash/scripts/run_trials.py unless the user explicitly reopens execution-layer work.
If historical components are intentionally selected, mark them as agent-selected and state the approximation gap.
If the adapter cannot express the proposed mechanism, report a blocker instead of silently reducing the idea to a historical route.

skill_v5_target_specific_information_les.main_lesson: A target identity feature is not a target-to-gene biological representation. Full 18,080-gene output and perturbation-conditioned training are not enough if the information available for an unseen target does not encode which genes are likely affected.
requirements_for_next_proposals: Prefer candidate data representations that expose gene-position-specific target information available at inference time.

Examples include provenance-safe perturbation signatures, target-to-affected-gene priors, regulatory target neighborhoods, pathway membership mapped to the official 18,080 genes, or condition-token designs whose condition carries biological content rather than only a label.

Treat GO similarity, generic gene embeddings, target IDs, and random hashes as weak target-specific information unless the proposal gives a falsifiable reason they can improve unseen-target residual prediction.
Do not continue a single weak architecture by minor tuning if the failure analysis points to missing target-specific biological information.

skill_v6_proposal_collision_lesson.main_lesson: Target-specific biology is not the same as generic control co-expression around the target gene.
skill_v6_proposal_collision_lesson.observed_candidate: Control-Derived Co-Expression Gated Perturbation Delta Predictor
skill_v6_proposal_collision_lesson.reason: ResearchStudio's own collision critic judged the idea too close to a co-expression / gene-geometry residual-flow family and noted that naive co-expression mostly captures stable baseline relationships rather than intervention-specific target effects.
requirements_for_next_proposals: Do not use control-derived co-expression alone as the target-to-gene effect representation.
Prefer provenance-safe perturbation signatures or target-to-affected-gene effect sources when available.
If co-expression or gene geometry is used, add an intervention-aware signal or a negative-control design showing it predicts perturbation residual rather than baseline correlation.
Consider changing representation, objective, or model family instead of making another small co-expression-gating variant.

gfect.reason: The successful official run used shuffled_target_control=true, so it is excluded from normal best-candidate ranking.

ps_de_vae.lesson: Control-derived regulatory profiles and a more complex VAE/FiLM decoder did not supply sufficient target-specific intervention information.

iffm.lesson: The proposal is not a scientific failure because execution did not produce a valid official score.

skill_v9_intervention_fingerprint_audit.main_lesson: Architecture complexity has not closed the gap to Lingshu. The next autonomous iteration should first audit whether VCC25 training perturbations can produce a stable target-to-gene intervention fingerprint.
required_audit_questions: How many perturbation cells exist for each training target?
How many target x batch groups are available and how balanced are they?
Is target_delta stable within target across batches and sampled cells?
Which genes have repeatable within-target response signs and magnitudes?
Which genes are low signal-to-noise and should not drive a target-specific prior?
How much information is added by target-specific residual over the global H1 prior?
Does any train-only target-to-gene fingerprint generalize across targets under strict leave-target-out tests?
skill_v9_intervention_fingerprint_audit.h200_gate: Do not enter a full H200 scientific run unless the data audit and candidate smoke show a usable target-specific intervention signal.
avoid_repeating: control-only co-expression as the main signal
random target hashes or target IDs as unseen-target biology
ordinary VAE/flow/transformer variants without a new target-to-gene signal
hidden-size or decoder-depth changes that do not change the scientific mechanism

source_provenance.local_smoke: official H1 raw counts -> Lingshu tokenizer -> model -> decode -> VCC schema PASS

suggested_hypotheses: Full-gene representation may help only when paired with a compatible model-facing token or count representation.
Target-specific target-to-gene priors should be prioritized over generic target similarity.
Gene-order and missingness audits should be mandatory preflights for full-gene external priors.
Representation experiments should change one data-processing variable at a time.
An explicitly perturbation-conditioned objective should be required before treating raw-count masked-token representation as a test of Lingshu-like knowledge transfer.
Before another full H200 run, audit whether train-only perturbation data can construct a stable target-to-gene intervention fingerprint for unseen-target response prediction.

transferable_insights.idea: Whole-transcriptome representation may preserve perturbation-relevant signal lost by aggressive gene filtering.
transferable_insights.not_a_requirement: Do not force every candidate to use full-gene tokens unless evidence supports the cost.
transferable_insights.research_implication: Compare full-gene representation against compact or target-level representations while keeping VCC25 split and evaluator fixed.

transferable_insights.idea: Raw integer counts and tokenization are coupled.
transferable_insights.not_a_requirement: This does not require using Lingshu tokenizer in non-Lingshu candidates.
transferable_insights.research_implication: Do not feed log1p deltas or normalized continuous values into a count tokenizer unless a new tokenizer contract is explicitly defined.

transferable_insights.idea: Gene order and vocabulary are scientific invariants.
transferable_insights.not_a_requirement: Shape equality alone is insufficient evidence of gene-order correctness.
transferable_insights.research_implication: Any full-gene candidate must audit exact 18,080-gene order compatibility and report truncation/missingness.

transferable_insights.idea: Perturbation condition should remain explicit rather than being hidden inside a target mean.
transferable_insights.not_a_requirement: Condition tokens do not solve target-specific residual unless the target information is predictive.
transferable_insights.research_implication: Consider condition-prefix, target-gene, cell-context, or control-condition representations as ablation variables.

transferable_insights.idea: Biological prior injection is useful only with clean provenance and controlled ablation.
transferable_insights.not_a_requirement: Do not use Lingshu clue CSV when provenance is UNKNOWN.
transferable_insights.research_implication: Test one provenance-safe target-to-gene prior at a time and keep validation/test expression out of prior construction.
